scope: Four completed DAgger training rounds only. The separate recovery-weight comparison is excluded from these four-round optimizer totals. Abandoned attempts are not part of this selected model ancestry; total GPU work is not claimed.

interpretation.expert_failures: 19 actual legal attempts were not rescued within this run. This does not establish that these states are intrinsically unrecoverable.
interpretation.late_coverage: Four successful records follow some student stable-grasp window; three have already lost the stability criterion at switch. Only one is still stable at actual handover. Expert-completed rotate/align/insert suffixes in earlier pickups are not student-origin late-stage coverage.
interpretation.stable_rule: Existing12 completed ticks, both physics samples at least2 object-contact fingertips >0.1N, height>=2cm above median completed25–48, palm-relative drift<=1cm and relative rotation<=0.2rad. Diagnostics only; no task-success change.
interpretation.angles: Current object-to-goal quaternion angle is reported at the same tick as stability, ignoring object symmetry. No new arbitrary turned-correctly threshold is imposed. Native near-goal/alignment are reported separately.
interpretation.training: Population legal ticks exclude full student prefix and actual2tick expert queue flush. Completed exposure and selected-checkpoint exposure are separate. Repeated exposure cannot create new physical recovery states.
interpretation.goals: All53 accepted corrections are pooled into both A andB within the same30 training families; they are not53 independent initial families. Validation6/test22 excluded.

next_collection_design.name: current_full_student_event_conditioned_late_recovery
next_collection_design.rationale: Most current corrections begin before any student stable grasp; extending fixed late clocks produced14 failed rescues in24 opportunities and only2 stable-window-triggered rescues. Current stable-at-switch source has only1 case/86 legal expert ticks.
next_collection_design.family_assignment: Identical family/order/trigger mapping for both roles. First3 families get immediate-stability handover; last3 get post-stability continuation. Uses original training starts only, no validation/development/test initial states.
next_collection_design.strata: Per role:3 handovers immediately after first completed existing stable-grasp window;3 at first subsequent loss of that same condition, or after60 further actual student ticks if stability persists. Categorize loss-triggered versus still-stable delayed handovers separately.
next_collection_design.fallback: No fixed-time expert rescue for a never-stable case in this late-coverage cohort. Record it as student failed to qualify and retain full autonomous trace; never count it as later-stage correction.
next_collection_design.proposal_status: Historical design suggestion from coverage audit; the subsequent reviewed selection and actual registration are authoritative.
next_collection_design.before_launch: Bind the selected complete reviewed pair and register its actual pair/source hashes and a concrete bounded cohort. If the selected pair still rarely qualifies, do not inflate the cohort with late unsuccessful pickups; report low eligibility and prioritize acquisition stability.
next_collection_design.supervision: Complete actual student prefix, fresh observed actual expert suffix, existing queue-clean mask. Successful suffixes only enter legal action supervision; failed/nonqualifying traces remain diagnostic evidence.
next_collection_design.completion: Report qualification/trigger/loss/at-switch stability and angle/distance, expert rescue outcomes and failures, exact source/learning exposure; then update DP, refresh all dependent visual/plan caches, train backend and evaluate full student on unchanged independent development cohort. No autonomous benefit assumed.
